proof_body:
by
  intro u g z hu hg
  have hev := hu.eventually
  obtain ⟨ε, hε, hball⟩ := Metric.eventually_nhds_iff_ball.mp hev
  have hh : InnerProductSpace.HarmonicOnNhd u (Metric.ball (g z) ε) := fun x hx => hball x hx
  obtain ⟨F, hF, hre⟩ := hh.exists_analyticOnNhd_ball_re_eq
  have hmem : g z ∈ Metric.ball (g z) ε := Metric.mem_ball_self hε
  have hFg : AnalyticAt ℂ (fun w => F (g w)) z := (hF (g z) hmem).comp hg
  have h1 := hFg.harmonicAt_re
  have hev2 : (fun w => (F (g w)).re) =ᶠ[nhds z] fun w => u (g w) := by
    have : ∀ᶠ w in nhds z, g w ∈ Metric.ball (g z) ε := hg.continuousAt.eventually_mem (Metric.isOpen_ball.mem_nhds hmem)
    filter_upwards [this] with w hw using hre hw
  exact (InnerProductSpace.harmonicAt_congr_nhds hev2).mp h1
target_source: ∀ (u : ℂ → ℝ) (g : ℂ → ℂ) (z : ℂ), InnerProductSpace.HarmonicAt u (g z) → AnalyticAt ℂ g z → InnerProductSpace.HarmonicAt (fun w => u (g w)) z
